review_goal: Reduce authorization lookup latency with a cache while preserving authoritative membership decisions.

directions.prompt: Follow remote calls, storage access, loops, batching, caches, and side effects for production-scale failure modes.
Check whether changed interfaces, schemas, configuration, migrations, and rollout order remain compatible.
Check trust boundaries, authorization, validation, and secret handling around the changed behavior.

findings.title: Avoid the authoritative lookup on cache hits
findings.body: When `Current` performs the remote or storage lookup this cache is intended to optimize, it is completed before `cache.Get`, so every cache hit still incurs the full latency and backend load and remains blocked by authority outages. Cache freshness must be established without completing the expensive `Current` call before returning the cached decision.
